async def act(page):
    """
    Steps to change the Home Page title to: "This is the home page!! Leave here!!"
    1. Navigate (relative) to the CMS pages listing.
    2. Click the "Home Page" link to open the editor.
    3. Update the "Page Title" field to the requested value (use label-based selector first).
    4. Click a Save button (try common accessible names, fall back to scanning buttons for visible text containing "Save").
    """
    import asyncio

    # 1) Navigate to the CMS pages listing using a relative URL
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/cms_page/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 2) Open the "Home Page" editor by clicking its link (accessibility selector)
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Home Page").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 3) Fill the Page Title field
    new_title = "This is the home page!! Leave here!!"
    try:
        # Prefer accessible label-based selector
        await page.get_by_label("Page Title").fill(new_title)
    except Exception:
        # Fallback: fill the first textbox on the page
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("textbox").nth(0).fill(new_title)
        except Exception:
            # If even that fails, raise so the test harness knows something went wrong
            raise

    # 4) Click Save. Try common accessible button names in order, then scan visible button text for "Save"
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save Page").click()
    except Exception:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
        except Exception:
            # Last-resort: find a button whose visible text contains "Save"
            buttons = page.get_by_role("button")
            count = await buttons.count()
            clicked = False
            for i in range(count):
                try:
                    text = await buttons.nth(i).text_content()
                    if text and "Save" in text:
                        await buttons.nth(i).click()
                        clicked = True
                        break
                except Exception:
                    continue
            if not clicked:
                # If no save button could be clicked, raise to indicate failure
                raise RuntimeError("Could not find or click a Save button")

    # short pause to allow save to complete and UI to update
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
